idea-plugin.name: Creation Date in Project View
idea-plugin.description:
Shows when a file or folder was created. Rest the mouse on a file or folder in the Project tool window and a small yellow balloon shows its creation date and time, read from the file system.

  • Works for files and folders on the local disk.
  • Nothing to configure: install it and hover.
  • English, or Dutch when your system language is Dutch.

Source code and updates: github.com/erikvandeblaak/creation-date-plugin
